'''Verston''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warrior]] who served under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tsalok]]. During the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]''<nowiki />'s [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook|rescue mission]] on [[Dibrook]] in [[25 ABY]], Verston informed Tsalok that [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] had made contact with them only to be dismissed by the [[Master Shaper]] [[Nagme]].<ref name="Rescues 5" />
